data.description: Once per hour, a wolliped can regurgitate the contents of its stomach, spitting the foul slurry at a single target within 10 feet as a ranged touch attack. On a successful hit, the target must succeed at a DC %1 Fortitude save or be sickened for 1d4 rounds.
data.name: Spit
